Get ready, Taurus—the celestial currents are about to stir your earthy ground in powerful ways.
Monday’s Mercury‑Venus sextile in your 2nd House boosts confidence, making it your best money day.
Tuesday’s Mars‑square to Venus in the 10th House spikes tension, urging a pause before aggressive career moves.
Wednesday’s Jupiter‑Saturn trine in the 5th House balances romance and duty, easing love concerns.
Thursday’s Venus retrograde stations in your 1st House, compelling you to rethink self‑image and rewrite love scripts.
The weekend’s Pluto opposition to your Sun stirs revelations that may expose hidden career obstacles. Sunday’s Moon‑Mercury sextile in the 3rd House sharpens communication, perfect for closing deals.
Best Day: Wednesday shines as Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance. Worst Day: Tuesday’s Mars‑Venus square ignites workplace tension.
Schedule a brief grounding meditation and draft a tight budget before Venus retrograde deepens uncertainty. Follow for daily updates.
